# Data Dawgs

> Forecasting, fantasy football, betting markets and EPA with receipts.
> All paths below are relative to https://datadawgs216.com/

Start with [`/data/index.json`](/data/index.json): machine-file
dates, sizes and SHA-256 receipts. Cite each payload's `as_of` with every number.

[`/data/surfaces.json`](/data/surfaces.json) maps pages to machine
surfaces and 43 live read-only MCP tools — every registered one. `planned` is not
callable. Two catalogs: `/mcp/core/<credential>` serves 16 everyday tools;
`/mcp/full/<credential>` and the bare `/mcp/<credential>` serve all 43. Prefer core —
43 schemas cost real context. Every tool carries a title; none of them writes. MCP tokens come from `/connect.html`;
`/signon.html` signup creates an account, not a league seat.

Tiers: `labs` is challenged; `dawg` validated; `pound` shelved — The DawgHouse. Do not overstate Labs.

## The DawgHouse

- [The shelf](/dawghouse.html) and its [inventory](/data/pound-tools.json): blocked NFL work with exact blockers, and 44 evidence-tracked CFB ideas. Sixteen production CFB tools ARE callable over MCP; the roadmap ideas are not, and a lifecycle state is not a capability claim.
- [Contracts](/data/model-contracts.json): forecast fields, receipt rules and calculator I/O.
- [Provenance](/data/upstream-models.json): repos, commits, dates, licenses, integration mode.
- [NFL schedule](/data/nfl-schedule.json): 272 validated 2026 games, locked snapshot.
- [538 Classic Elo](/data/538-classic.json) ([method](/data/538-classic-methodology.md)): 32 ratings, 272 ungraded forecasts, reproduced historically.
- [Normalized model receipts](/data/model-receipts.json): 544 append-only prospective forecasts across nfelo and 538 Classic.

- [Calculators](/calculators.html): 10 deterministic calculators — odds, vig, EV, hedging,
passer rating, Elo, margin translation, forecast scoring, belief summary. Inputs are not
stored. The model scoreboard and upstream provenance render on /receipts.html.

## Arena

- [Arena](/arena.html): the games played against other people — Bozo, Guillotine, Survivor, DFS,
the live draft rig. Rendered from the `domain: "arena"` rows of surfaces.json; owns no data file.

## College football

- [CFB Lab](/cfb.html): explorer, matchup calculator, Elo backtest, divergence, and the 44-idea build roadmap (moved from the workbench 2026-08-09).
- [2025 results](/data/cfb-schedule.json): 934 games; [latest games](/data/cfb-games-latest.json): one final per FBS team; [latest periods](/data/cfb-team-week-latest.json): one per team; [ratings](/data/cfb-teams.json): records + retrodictive Elo.
- [Book market](/data/cfb-market.json): spreads, totals and devigged moneylines. Books are named but observation time is unknown; these are not closing lines and cannot establish CLV.
- [CFB Elo](/data/cfb-elo.json), [registry](/data/cfb-ratings.json) and [card](/data/cfb-model-cards.json): end-2025; retrodictive, modelled, ungraded, not consensus or forecast.
- [Fraud test](/data/cfb-record-divergence-validation.json): small held-out lift beyond Elo; retrodictive, no team labels. [Disagreement](/data/cfb-disagreement.json): blocked on timestamped prices.
- [Prospective receipts](/data/cfb-model-receipts.json): append-only contract, zero rows; no CFB forecast has been frozen before kickoff.
- The 24-to-25-hour CFB market collector is staged; its endpoint is not live yet.

## Draft

- [Player pool + Market Value](/data/pool.json): 459 players; three auction formats; `as_of 2026-07-29`. MV is not projected points.
- [League](/data/league.json): 14 teams, $200, 15 spots, half PPR, no kicker, plus the public draft mirror.
- [2026 strategy](/data/strategy.md): positional curves and format playbooks; testable structure kept apart from analyst priors.

## Models and data

- [Team + QB EPA](/data/epa-teams.json): 2023-2025 nflverse play-by-play; descriptive, not predictive.
- [nfelo](/data/nfelo.json): ratings and backtest with the in-sample caveat.
- [Schedule + win probabilities](/data/survivor.json): 272 games; market-derived where available, model-derived otherwise.
- [Parameters](/data/models.json): margin, Bozo and survivor assumptions and limitations.

## Receipts and method

- [Pre-registered forecasts](/data/receipts.json): 272 calls locked 2026-08-06, SHA-256 `4b87fe0e0790a1e6…`.
- [Receipt method](/data/receipts-method.md): hypotheses, grading, hash reproduction, and what the tier collar means.
- [Bozo rules](/data/bozo-rules.json) ([prose](/data/bozo-rules.md)): open weekly one-leg parlay game.
- [House reasoning rules](/data/method.md): base rates, ranges, falsifiers and selection-bias checks.
- [Toto philosophy](/data/toto-philosophy.md): reasoning conventions for the site AI.

## Agent notes

- If a dated number is stale enough to affect the answer, say so.
- `def_epa_play` is EPA allowed: lower is better.
- Simulation and modelled output are labelled; do not present either as observation.
- Nothing here is betting advice.
- `/data/` is public, static, CORS-open and cheaper than the self-contained HTML pages.
